mira: Quick heads-up — did a hetero-quant smoke sweep for atlas-13b with FP8 kernel enabled on both H100 and L40S nodes. Filing here before I open a formal ticket. TL;DR: FP8 path gives best perf but we hit a longprefix numeric instability on one L40S run and mixed-precision softmax/matmul handoff shows subtle generation deltas.

alan: which eval sets and seeds? calibration set size?

mira: calib = subset of convQA (2k examples), seed=42, eval = convQA + codegen-small + 1000 random LM prompts. baseline = fp32, variants = awq-4bit, gptq-4bit, int8-symmetric, fp8-runtime (mixed-prec kernel selection).

alan: ok. numbers?

mira: results summary (exact-match / avg-perp where relevant):
- baseline fp32: EM 78.9% / perp 12.4
- awq-4bit: EM 78.1% (-0.8) / perp 12.8
- gptq-4bit: EM 78.5% (-0.4) / perp 12.6
- int8-symmetric: EM 77.1% (-1.8) / perp 13.5 (outliers on math prompts)
- fp8-runtime (hetero): EM 78.3% (-0.6) / perp 12.7; p50 latency H100: -28% tokens/sec improvement vs fp32, L40S: -24%
Notes: fp8 gives best perf/quality tradeoff among quantized options; int8 had the largest drop.

tess: what was the failure mode on L40S?

mira: L40S longprefix run (~8k tokens) hit an activation saturation in the FP8 matmul path leading to occasional NaNs, triggered fallback to FP32 but KV cache scaling mismatch left a token glitch in ~1/5000 calls. H100 didn't reproduce under same workload.

raj: can we reproduce with a deterministic repro? need stack trace + exact kernel selection log. If it's kv-scale related we should force `kv_scale_rescale: true` in config for canary.

mira: posted run log excerpt below (truncated):
```
[2026-03-19T14:02:11Z] kernel_select: matmul=fp8, softmax=fp32
[2026-03-19T14:02:12Z] kv_cache_scale: 1.000 -> 0.996 (rescale)
[2026-03-19T14:02:12Z] runtime: nan detected in activation. fallback_policy=soft-fallback -> rerun chunk in fp32
[2026-03-19T14:02:12Z] result: fallback succeeded but token 172 produced slight diff
```

olivia: let's lock the calibration config in the eval repo and attach the `quant_backend` and `calib_samples` metadata so we can trace exactly which calibration produced the artifact. Also add a regression alert if EM drops >0.5% for convQA.

alan: for canary strategy I suggest: 1) small traffic shadow on L40S w/ fp8 on 1% for 48h 2) enable auto-fallback to gptq when NaN/fallback count > 5/10k 3) preserve fp32 rollout button.

raj: +1. Also add an A/B evaluation harness that compares greedy generations token-by-token for a fixed seed and flags first-token-diff > 0.1% as a hard-fail.

mira: config I used: 
```
model: atlas-13b
runtime:
  enable_fp8: true
  fallback_policy: [soft-fallback, kernel-fallback]
  kernel_order: [matmul, rms_norm, softmax]
quant:
  backends: [awq,gptq,int8]
  calib_samples: 2000
  kv_scale_rescale: false
```

lint-bot: reminder: please include `rollout_ticket` label on PRs touching runtime kernels.

deploy-bot: canary deployment initiated for atlas-13b fp8 on zone-us-west-2-l40s (traffic=0.5%)

tess: perf/cost note — fp8 path shows ~35% token-cost reduction vs fp32 on H100 when batching is effective. For small-batch low-latency use cases savings are smaller (~15%).

olivia: action items?

mira: short list:
- (mira) open a reproducible `longprefix` smoke test + attach full kernel log (today)
- (raj) add kv_scale_rescale toggle + canary fallback rule (tomorrow)
- (alan) wire the A/B harness token-diff detector into canary metrics (48h)
- (tess) run 48h shadow perf/cost dashboard and export p50/p95 latency by backend (start today)
- (olivia) add regression alert for convQA EM >0.5% drop (end of week)

mira: thanks — will post PR + ticket. If anyone wants the raw eval artifacts ping me and I'll rsync them to the shared bucket. :thumbsup:

alan: flagged. Thanks for the writeup.
